title: Teacher Appointment
prompt:
Rhea offers Byleth the teaching post with a small ceremonial gesture. Byleth receives the offer in composed silence. Jeralt's profile tightens beside Byleth, clearly uneasy. The invitation should feel like destiny and trap at the same time.

Camera: slow push from Rhea's gesture to Byleth and Jeralt. Rhea must remain a breathtakingly beautiful young adult woman in her mid-20s with smooth youthful skin; express ancient dragon divinity through calm sacred authority, not wrinkles, eye bags, tired texture, or middle-aged features.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: written contracts, magical UI, overacting, visible modern props. Avoid old Rhea, middle-aged Rhea, tired priestess face, wrinkles, eye bags. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
